title: The Per-Place Price of a Vacation Package Where Component Lines Stand Against It
content:
Where component lines stand on the ledger of a package among the Vacation Package Products, the per-place price is worked from the quoted price together with those lines, and the children shown on the package record decide what the division is made by. The component lines are totalled with their signs, so a line carrying a negative amount reduces the total rather than adding to it.

| Component lines standing against the package | Children shown on the package record | How the per-place price is worked |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | 1 or more | the quoted package price is taken together with the signed total of those component lines and divided by the adults and the children counted together |
| 1 or more | 0 | the quoted package price is taken together with the signed total of those component lines and divided by the adults shown on the record |
| 0 | either | not worked on this basis |

**Where children are travelling.** Where the ledger carries component lines against the package and the package record shows children travelling, the quoted package price is taken together with the signed total of those component lines and divided by the adults and the children counted together.

**Where no children are travelling.** Where the ledger carries component lines against the package and the package record shows no children travelling, the quoted package price is taken together with the signed total of those component lines and divided by the adults shown on the record alone.

**Where no component line stands.** Where the count of component lines standing against the package is 0, the per-place price is not worked on this basis, whether or not children are shown on the record.

*Worked hypothetically.* A package quoted at 5,000.00 USD, whose record shows 2 adults and 2 children, and whose ledger carries component lines totalling 400.00 USD with their signs: the quoted price taken together with those lines is 5,400.00 USD, divided by 4, giving a per-place price of 1,350.00 USD.

The same package with no children shown on the record and 2 adults: 5,400.00 USD divided by 2, giving a per-place price of 2,700.00 USD.
